d.seg: En phone number venume, ippo na eppadi unga kitta contact pannitu varadhu?
d.tr: I need your phone number, how will I contact you to come?
d.j: The user is explicitly requesting a phone number to move the conversation off-platform.

d.seg: Naan unga kitta cash kekka koodadhu, aana nerla vandha unakku 1500 illana 2000, 2000 kaiyila tharen.
d.tr: I shouldn't ask for cash, but if you come in person, I will give you 1500 or 2000, 2000 in hand.
d.j: The user is offering a specific amount of money in exchange for an in-person meeting.

d.seg: Seri, appo un phone number thariya?
d.tr: Okay, so will you give your phone number?
d.j: The user is explicitly requesting a phone number to move the conversation off-platform.

d.seg: Okay va, un kaiyila, un kaiyila cash tharen, adhu kapram namma room kulla polam.
d.tr: Okay, I will give cash in your hand, after that we can go into the room.
d.j: The user is offering money in exchange for an in-person meeting and room stay.
